Read execution records, filter project history, and wait for terminal state.

## `ExecutionsClient`

Read and poll the executor's project-scoped execution records.

### `get`

Retrieves one execution record by identifier.

```ts no-check
get(executionId: string): Promise<ExecutionRecord>
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `executionId` | <code>string</code> | Yes | Execution identifier returned by `tools.execute`. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;ExecutionRecord&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError when the execution is unavailable or the request fails.

### `list`

Lists execution history with optional status, tool, user, and cursor filters.

```ts no-check
list(options?: ListExecutionsOptions): Promise<ExecutionPage>
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | <code>ListExecutionsOptions</code> | No | Filters and pagination for the project execution history. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;ExecutionPage&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError when a filter is invalid or the executor request fails.

### `wait`

Polls an execution until it succeeds or fails, bounded by a local deadline.

```ts no-check
wait(executionId: string, options?: WaitForExecutionOptions): Promise<(ExecutionBase & { userId: string; createdAt: string; startedAt?: string; completedAt?: string; } & { status: "succeeded"; output: JsonValue; error?: never; latencyMs: number; } & { status: "succeeded" | "failed"; }) | (ExecutionBase & { userId: string; createdAt: string; startedAt?: string; completedAt?: string; } & { status: "failed"; output?: never; error: NormalizedToolError; latencyMs: number; } & { status: "succeeded" | "failed"; })>
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `executionId` | <code>string</code> | Yes | Execution identifier returned by `tools.execute`. |
| `options` | <code>WaitForExecutionOptions</code> | No | Poll interval and total timeout in milliseconds. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;(ExecutionBase &amp; &#123; userId: string; createdAt: string; startedAt?: string; completedAt?: string; &#125; &amp; &#123; status: "succeeded"; output: JsonValue; error?: never; latencyMs: number; &#125; &amp; &#123; status: "succeeded" &#124; "failed"; &#125;) &#124; (ExecutionBase &amp; &#123; userId: string; createdAt: string; startedAt?: string; completedAt?: string; &#125; &amp; &#123; status: "failed"; output?: never; error: NormalizedToolError; latencyMs: number; &#125; &amp; &#123; status: "succeeded" &#124; "failed"; &#125;)&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError with `timeout` when the deadline expires, or the executor's normalized error for a failed request.
- Error When an injected polling clock returns a non-finite timestamp.

**Example**

```ts
import { Eyeball } from "@eyeball/sdk";

const eyeball = new Eyeball({
  apiKey: process.env.EYEBALL_API_KEY!,
  baseUrl: process.env.EYEBALL_EXECUTOR_URL!,
});

const execution = { executionId: "exe_01JZ6WA0Q73ZQ5B51SRYB6M4Z8" };

const terminal = await eyeball.executions.wait(execution.executionId, {
  pollMs: 500,
  timeoutMs: 60_000,
});
```

## Types

### `ListExecutionsOptions`

Project execution-history filters and cursor controls.

```ts no-check
export interface ListExecutionsOptions {
  status?: ExecutionStatus;
  /** Canonical dotted or restricted wire name. */
  tool?: string;
  /** Uses the client-level userId when omitted. */
  userId?: string;
  cursor?: string;
  limit?: number;
}
```

| Property | Type | Required | Readonly | Description |

| `cursor` | <code>string</code> | No | No | — |
| `limit` | <code>number</code> | No | No | — |
| `status` | <code>ExecutionStatus</code> | No | No | — |
| `tool` | <code>string</code> | No | No | Canonical dotted or restricted wire name. |
| `userId` | <code>string</code> | No | No | Uses the client-level userId when omitted. |

### `WaitForExecutionOptions`

Local polling cadence and deadline for terminal execution state.

```ts no-check
export interface WaitForExecutionOptions {
  /** Milliseconds between polls. Defaults to 500. */
  pollMs?: number;
  /** Total milliseconds before a timeout error. Defaults to 60,000. */
  timeoutMs?: number;
}
```

| Property | Type | Required | Readonly | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pollMs` | <code>number</code> | No | No | Milliseconds between polls. Defaults to 500. |
| `timeoutMs` | <code>number</code> | No | No | Total milliseconds before a timeout error. Defaults to 60,000. |

|---|---|---|---|---|

### `AsyncExecuteResponse`



```ts no-check
export type AsyncExecuteResponse = ExecutionBase & { status: "pending" };
```

### `ExecutionId`



```ts no-check
export type ExecutionId = `exe_${string}`;
```

### `ExecutionMode`



```ts no-check
export type ExecutionMode = "sync" | "async";
```

### `ExecutionRecord`



```ts no-check
export type ExecutionRecord = ExecutionBase & {
  userId: string;
  createdAt: string;
  startedAt?: string;
  completedAt?: string;
} & (
    | {
        status: "pending" | "running";
        output?: never;
        error?: never;
        latencyMs?: never;
      }
    | {
        status: "succeeded";
        output: JsonValue;
        error?: never;
        latencyMs: number;
      }
    | {
        status: "failed";
        output?: never;
        error: NormalizedToolError;
        latencyMs: number;
      }
  );
```

### `ExecutionResult`

The immediate result of POST /v1/execute in either execution mode.

```ts no-check
export type ExecutionResult = SyncExecuteResponse | AsyncExecuteResponse;
```

### `ExecutionStatus`



```ts no-check
export type ExecutionStatus = "pending" | "running" | "succeeded" | "failed";
```
